descriptions.code-reviewer: Reviews a diff for bugs, regressions, missing tests, and broken conventions. Use after a meaningful change or when the user asks for a review. Read-only.
descriptions.security-reviewer: Reviews auth, secrets, user input, payments, and personal data. Use when a change touches those surfaces or the user asks for a security review. Read-only.
descriptions.database-reviewer: Reviews SQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, RLS, and migrations. Use for a schema or query change. Read-only.
descriptions.ecosystem-auditor: Audits OpenCode and Claude Code harness parity. Use for /ecosystem-audit or a harness-coherence check. Read-only.
descriptions.e2e-runner: Runs browser end-to-end flows and writes their artifacts. Use for Playwright or a critical user flow. The log stays out of the main session.
descriptions.why-investigator: Investigates one evidence category, git history or one MCP, for design rationale. Use from the why skill, one category per investigator, in parallel. Read-only.
descriptions.build-error-resolver: Fixes build, typecheck, and lint errors with a minimal diff. Use when the build is red and the log is large.
